name: final-20261110
status: Exploratory. Frozen before any quantity below was computed. O'Neil has been inspected extensively, so no result here is confirmatory. The failed NCATS confirmation, the frozen ablation seed limits and the 5% materiality threshold are unchanged; no ablation seed is added.
preceding_observations: Pooled repeat-row dispersion 83.34 points^2; replicate deviations 5.44% of row variance; pair-cell contrast 2.60%, dose-shape contrast 10.18% of row variance (research_20261107/resolution).
Selected F2 interaction-residual R^2 0.064 [drug -0.037, 0.165]; contrast R^2 0.359; Bliss contrast R^2 0.315.
C1 replaces 67/1,137 native top-5% pair-cell choices; entrants median native margin 3.60, exits 0.17.
No replicate-split noise energy, cross-cell pair oracle or pair-cell-fold training result had been computed.

common.units: Dose rows are never independent units. Inference resamples whole unordered drug pairs (2000 draws, seed 20261110) and deletes one drug at a time with every evaluation projection refitted.
common.evaluation_operators: Unchanged cs622.resolution projections: pair-cell contrast (P-A) and dose-shape contrast (E-P-D), fitted within cell and original pair fold with replicate-count weights. Bliss residual targets use the training-pair Bliss reference already cached for the historical comparisons.
common.multiplicity: One primary endpoint per direction; no Holm family is shared with historical endpoints.

direction_A_replicate_noise.question: How much of each evaluation target and of the Loewe shortlist is explained by combination-replicate measurement noise?

A1_noise_ceilings.estimand: For target T = C y, noise energy N_C = E||C eps_bar||_W^2 of replicate-mean noise; ceiling R^2 = 1 - N_C/||C y||^2; noise-corrected model R^2 = 1 - (||C e||^2 - N_C)/(||C y||^2 - N_C).
A1_noise_ceilings.estimator: Within each pair-cell, split its blocks into two equal halves (4 -> 2+2, 8 -> 4+4). For every identical-input unit, d = sqrt(n1 n2)/n (mean half 1 - mean half 2) has the variance of the full replicate-mean noise and zero mean. N_C is ||C d||^2, averaged over 50 random block partitions (seed 20261110). Operators are applied to d exactly as to y.
A1_noise_ceilings.models: Cached historical predictions only: selected neural F2 and F0 (3 seeds), production F2 (f2_base, 3 seeds), GP F2, CF selected extension, mono_only, Bliss.
A1_noise_ceilings.primary: Noise share N_C/||C(y - r_B)||^2 of the Bliss-residual pair-cell contrast, with pair-bootstrap and drug-jackknife intervals.
A1_noise_ceilings.interpretation: Noise share <= 0.2 (upper interval bound): replicate noise cannot explain interaction-residual R^2 near 0.06; the unexplained interaction contrast is reproducible across replicate blocks. Noise share >= 0.5: the interaction target is mostly replicate noise. Otherwise intermediate.
A1_noise_ceilings.limitations: Replicate blocks may share plates or processing, so N_C can underestimate independent-repeat noise and ceilings are upper bounds. Monotherapy is shared across blocks, so monotherapy measurement noise is not represented.

A2_shortlist_noise.estimand: Top-5% pair-cell Loewe shortlist turnover caused by combination-replicate resampling, compared with the fixed-data N -> C1 turnover (67/1,137).
A2_shortlist_noise.scores: Block scores under N, C1 and I from cs622.decision_sensitivity references and unit_scores with the historical inputs; pair-cell score = mean of block scores.
procedures: Half-split: 200 random equal block partitions per pair-cell; turnover between half-screen lists under the same convention.

Bootstrap: 1000 resamples of blocks within pair-cell (seed 20261110); selection probability of every unit under N and C1 computed on the same resample; N -> C1 turnover within each resample; N turnover between consecutive independent resamples.
A2_shortlist_noise.primary: Within-resample N -> C1 top-5% turnover distribution, and mean selection probability of the 67 C1 entrants under N and under C1.
A2_shortlist_noise.interpretation: The C1 change is systematic beyond replicate noise if the within-resample turnover 2.5% quantile is above zero and C1 entrants have mean selection probability < 0.1 under N and >= 0.5 under C1. Noise turnover is reported as context; a larger noise turnover does not make a bias disappear.
A2_shortlist_noise.limitations: Combination replicates only; monotherapy, fit and plate uncertainty are not represented. A 4-block bootstrap is coarse.

direction_B_pair_information.question: Is the weak held-out-pair interaction prediction an information limit (the pair-specific interaction is reproducible across cells but not inferable from other pairs) or a model limit?

B1_cross_cell_oracle.target: Bliss-residual pair-cell contrast t = (P-A)(y - r_B) (primary); raw pair-cell contrast (secondary).
oracles: LOCO: mean of the same pair's contrast in every other cell, projected by (P-A) in the evaluated cell/fold.
Split-matched: mean over cells whose pair-cell fold (B2 assignment) is a training fold for the evaluated pair-cell.
B1_cross_cell_oracle.secondary: Cross-cell covariance share: pooled mean of t_pc t_pc' over c != c' divided by pooled mean of t_pc^2 (noise-robust share of pair-consistent energy).
B1_cross_cell_oracle.comparators: Held-out-pair production F2 (f2_base, 3 seeds) and selected F2.
B1_cross_cell_oracle.gate_for_B2: Run B2 only if split-matched oracle R^2 minus production F2 held-out R^2 on the primary target is >= 0.10 with pair-bootstrap lower bound > 0. Otherwise report that pair-consistent interaction is too small to motivate retraining and stop direction B.
B1_cross_cell_oracle.note: Oracles read other cells of the evaluated pair. They are information diagnostics, not held-out-pair predictors.

B2_pair_seen_training.hypothesis: With the pair observed in other cells, the frozen production F2 procedure captures substantially more Bliss-residual pair-cell contrast than under held-out pairs.
B2_pair_seen_training.competing: (i) The architecture cannot represent pair-specific interaction even when trained on the pair (representation limit). (ii) Gains are response-level or additive rather than contrast-level.
B2_pair_seen_training.split: Pair-cell folds: every pair-cell (all blocks and orientations) in one fold. Per pair, cells are sorted, permuted (numpy default_rng seed 20261110) and assigned round-robin from a random offset, so each pair has 7-8 cells per fold. Test f, validation (f+1)%5, other three train. Monotherapy only from training blocks.
B2_pair_seen_training.model: Production F2 exactly as results/neural/runs/sprint_v1/runs/f2_base: configs/neural_monotherapy.json with mono_missing interpolate, device cuda, eval_batch_size 16384. No search, no selection beyond the original validation checkpoint rule.
B2_pair_seen_training.controls: Existing held-out-pair f2_base predictions for the same seeds and all rows.
B2_pair_seen_training.primary: Change in interaction-residual R^2 (Bliss-residual pair-cell contrast), pair-seen minus held-out-pair, seed-averaged errors, identical rows and original evaluation operators.
secondary: fraction of split-matched oracle gain captured
B2_pair_seen_training.decision: Exploitable pair information: change >= 0.05 with both grouped intervals above zero and at least 4/5 original folds positive. Representation-limited: change < 0.05 or an interval including zero while the oracle gate passed. Report the oracle fraction in both cases.
B2_pair_seen_training.checks: Before training: no test pair-cell block in training or validation; every test drug and cell seen in training; monotherapy rows only from training blocks; assignment hash recorded. After: finite predictions, every row predicted exactly once across folds.
B2_pair_seen_training.resources: One allocated GPU, 4 CPUs, 16 GiB, 30 minute cap per task, one active task. Expected 15 x 1-6 min; budget ceiling 7.5 GPU hours.
B2_pair_seen_training.stopping: Exactly 15 tasks. Diagnose any failure; rerun only affected tasks after a documented fix. No added seeds, models, masks or datasets based on outcomes.
B2_pair_seen_training.interpretation_limits: Compares learning procedures with different information on identical rows. It is not a deployable benchmark and does not identify biological mechanism. Random pair-cell splits are known to inflate performance; the estimand here is the contrast-level share of that gain.
